:::caution[deprecated]

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

:::

Finishes a released work unit — the RecordCompletion use case. Transitions Released → Completed and publishes `WorkUnitCompleted`, which updates backlog telemetry projections. Enforces the `WorkUnit` aggregate's at-most-once-completion invariant: completing an already completed unit, or one that was never released, returns `409`. This endpoint is also the target of the additive `TaskCompleted` Kafka consumer (Task 8) — fulfillment-execution's task completion drives the exact same use case as this HTTP call. Superseded by the `TaskCompleted` consumer (K14): fulfillment-execution publishes task completion on Kafka and this service consumes it to drive the same use case; removal planned with the next breaking window.
